headline: Marban Hollow Leads Fresh Flurry of Frontline Flips
war_summary: The wires quicken again after the quiet hours, with Marban Hollow furnishing three changes in the last two hours around Oster Wall and Checkpoint Bua, timed at 23:55 for the freshest flip on the board and listed four Warden to three Colonial with one base neutral, while Nevish Line adds two in two hours and five in six around Blackcoat Way, Grief Mother and Tomb Father, now six Warden to two Colonial, and Weathered Expanse adds two in two hours among eighteen on the day around Spirit Watch, Crow's Nest and Necropolis, held six Warden to one Colonial with two neutral. Stlican Shelf, the freshest flip in the last edition, shows none in two hours and one in six amid fourteen on the day around Breaker Town, still one Warden to eight Colonial, and Fisherman's Row, Linn Mercy, Palantine Berm and Godcrofts record no change in two or six hours despite day totals of four, twenty, thirty and forty-six, the last still all Colonial. Callahan's Passage again posts the heaviest two-hour casualty bill at 1,515 Colonial and 717 Warden without a day flip, with losses accelerating on both sides.
